# A8Z

> A8Z is an outbound-as-a-service agency for B2B tech companies. We book qualified sales meetings with technical buyers through end-to-end outbound: signal-based prospecting, social listening, personalized email, LinkedIn and cold calling, including pre-booked meetings at industry conferences such as RSAC, AWS re:Invent, Microsoft Ignite, KubeCon and Google Cloud Next.

Key facts:
- What: outbound as a service (done-for-you outbound) for B2B technology companies, plus pre-booked sales meetings at industry conferences and trade shows.
- Who it is for: founders and CEOs of B2B tech companies with 10-50 employees, and CROs, VP Sales and Heads of Sales at companies with 10-200 employees, especially in cloud, cloud software, DevOps and cybersecurity.
- Who they reach: technical and business buyers such as CTOs, VPs of Engineering, Heads of Platform, CISOs and their teams.
- Scope: end to end. Prospecting and list building, buying signals and social listening, cold email, LinkedIn, cold calling, reply handling and meeting booking. Small, targeted lists, not mass campaigns.
- Conferences covered: RSAC, AWS re:Invent, Microsoft Ignite, KubeCon + CloudNativeCon, Google Cloud Next, regional AWS Summits and Google Cloud Summits, Web Summit and other large cloud and security events in the US and Europe.
- Track record: 500+ meetings booked with technical buyers.
- Founder: Or Alperovitz, a former B2B SaaS seller to technical buyers.
- Based in Israel. Works with B2B tech companies in Israel, the US and Europe; outreach is in English.
- Contact: or@a8z.biz | Book a call: https://calendly.com/or-alperovitch-g9d9/30min

## Services

- [Outbound as a Service](https://a8z.biz/outbound-as-a-service/): End-to-end outbound for B2B tech companies: signal-based prospecting, social listening, personalized email, LinkedIn and cold calling, reply handling and qualified meetings with technical buyers. How A8Z works, who it's for, and what you get.

## Conference meeting booking

- [Conference and trade show meeting booking](https://a8z.biz/conference-meeting-booking/): A8Z pre-books sales meetings for B2B tech vendors attending conferences like RSAC, AWS re:Invent, Microsoft Ignite, KubeCon and Google Cloud Next. Pre-event outreach to attendees and target accounts, booked meetings, and post-event follow-up.
- [AWS re:Invent meeting booking](https://a8z.biz/conference-meeting-booking/aws-reinvent/): A8Z books sales meetings for B2B software vendors and AWS partners attending AWS re:Invent in Las Vegas (2026: November 30 to December 4). Pre-event outreach to cloud buyers, AWS partners and target accounts.
- [AWS Summits meeting booking](https://a8z.biz/conference-meeting-booking/aws-summits/): A8Z books sales meetings for B2B software vendors at regional AWS Summits in the US and Europe, such as New York, Washington DC, London and Hamburg. Pre-event outreach to local cloud buyers and AWS partners.
- [Google Cloud Next 2027 meeting booking](https://a8z.biz/conference-meeting-booking/google-cloud-next-2027/): A8Z books sales meetings for B2B software vendors and Google Cloud partners attending Google Cloud Next 2027 in Las Vegas. Pre-event outreach to cloud buyers, Google Cloud partners and target accounts.
- [Google Cloud Summits meeting booking](https://a8z.biz/conference-meeting-booking/google-cloud-summits/): A8Z books sales meetings for B2B software vendors at regional Google Cloud Summits, such as London, Paris, DACH, Nordics and Tel Aviv. Pre-event outreach to local cloud buyers and Google Cloud partners.
- [KubeCon Europe 2027 meeting booking](https://a8z.biz/conference-meeting-booking/kubecon-eu-2027/): A8Z books sales meetings for cloud native and DevOps vendors attending KubeCon + CloudNativeCon Europe 2027 (March 15-18, Barcelona). Pre-event outreach to platform engineering leaders and target accounts.
- [Microsoft Ignite meeting booking](https://a8z.biz/conference-meeting-booking/microsoft-ignite/): A8Z books sales meetings for B2B software vendors and Microsoft partners attending Microsoft Ignite (2026: November 17-20, Moscone Center, San Francisco). Pre-event outreach to IT, cloud and security leaders.
- [RSAC 2027 meeting booking](https://a8z.biz/conference-meeting-booking/rsac-2027/): A8Z books sales meetings for cybersecurity vendors attending RSAC 2027, formerly RSA Conference (April 5-8, Moscone Center, San Francisco). Pre-event outreach to CISOs, security leaders and target accounts, starting 6-8 weeks before the show.

## Guides

- [How to book meetings before a trade show or conference](https://a8z.biz/guides/book-meetings-before-a-trade-show/): A step-by-step playbook for B2B tech vendors to book sales meetings before a conference or trade show: timeline, who to target, where to find attendees, message templates and follow-up.
- [Outbound agency vs in-house SDR](https://a8z.biz/guides/outbound-agency-vs-in-house-sdr/): A practical comparison of hiring an outbound agency versus an in-house SDR for B2B tech companies: cost components, time to first meeting, risk, control, and when each option makes sense.
- [Free cold email infrastructure guide](https://a8z.biz/lm/email-infra-playbook-free/): Free guide: the 8 cold email infrastructure mistakes that kill deliverability and how to fix each one. Send limits, inbox warm-up, DNS settings and a pre-campaign checklist.
